digest.component_or_area: metrics analyzer toolchain and dev bootstrap
propositions: The dev bootstrap paths (make install and make install-unlocked) must explicitly name the metrics extra to pin the intent of providing analyzers independently of CI rationale

lizard is already transitively installed via the dev extra's self-reference to nava-rebar[agents,metrics] but this dependency is undocumented in bootstrap, risking silent regression if the self-reference is later removed
scc and jscpd (non-Python analyzers) cannot be installed via extras and must be documented as optional install steps with commands: brew install scc and npm install -g jscpd
Absence of scc and jscpd must degrade gracefully to Unavailable in rebar metrics output rather than causing hard failures
make worktree delegates to make install and requires no separate edit to gain metrics support from the Makefile change
